session_notes: Fatigue check-in: your last three sessions (07-20 A, 07-23 B, 07-26 C) hit RPE 9-10 on almost every set, several with reps dropping off across the set (e.g. shoulder press 12/10/8, lateral raise 10/10/8), and you flagged low energy on 07-20. That's outside the program's target zone (RPE 8-9 main lifts, 7-8 accessories) and is a fatigue signal, not a strength problem. Today: every weight holds, and accessory rep targets are trimmed to bring effort back down. If a lift still grinds to RPE 10 at these lighter targets, that's useful data - flag it in the session notes.
